name: Schema Migrator
description: Reconciles a loaded save payload against the current default shape so fields added after a player's last session materialise instead of reading nil. Complements persistence.datastore_safe: that component guarantees the bytes arrive, this one guarantees they have the right shape. Deep-merges saved values onto a freshly built default tree (saved scalars win, absent keys inherit defaults, nested tables recurse) and runs ordered version migrations for shape changes a merge cannot express, such as a renamed key or a scalar promoted to a table. Without it, every consumer of a save payload has to nil-guard every nested field at each call site forever.

implementations.note: Pure table transform. Fully deterministic and unit-testable with no platform services.

provenance: Surfaced by the same defect pass (2026-09-11): a view indexed Stats.ItemsDesigned on a payload saved before the Stats table existed, and the local fix was a nil-guard that would have to be repeated at every future call site. Searched first: persistence.datastore_safe guarantees the bytes arrive and says nothing about their shape, persistence.save_system and persistence.profile_adapter move payloads without reconciling them, persistence.limited_save budgets writes; none merge a loaded payload onto current defaults. Library-native, written as a pure table transform with no platform services.
